stories.title: Council tax support in Flintshire cost £14.6m last year, up 10.5 per cent
stories.summary: Flintshire’s council tax support bill rose by almost £1.4m last year while the number of households receiving help fell. Welsh Government figures show the Council Tax Reduction Scheme wrote £14.615m off council tax bills in Flintshire in the year to March 2026. That compares with £13.227m the year before, a rise of 10.5 per cent.
